# clo_project_limits (Resource)

Manage the specified project limits. Removing a limit or destroying this resource leaves its last value in CLO. Manage each project and limit pair in one resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `limits` (Map of Number) Maximum values keyed by addresses, dbaas-clusters, disk-space, loadbalancer, s3-max-space or servers.
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Imports all enabled writable limits in the project.
terraform import clo_project_limits.example PROJECT_ID
```
